Repeat.
5254-6495-6774.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Repeat.

1824-2530-2906-4740.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
